Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "hi this is lena ortiz from the north gallery team and i’m dictating a request about the shared folder sync client we use for the exhibit planning files i’m not asking anyone to move or delete the archive today i need help making the current sync behavior predictable before our next round of edits the folder is called north gallery install and the working copy is on the office desktop named juniper and on my laptop called fieldbook those are the only two devices i want included in this request

we started using the folder in february and it now contains the floor plan the lighting schedule vendor notes and photos from the walkthrough there are 326 files in it and the folder uses 8.4 gigabytes on the desktop the laptop has 21 gigabytes free so storage is not the problem the issue is that when i open a large photo the client sometimes starts uploading several other files at once and the call with the installer gets choppy i noticed it first on monday morning while i was reviewing the east wall images with dev shah

please look at the upload setting in the client and tell me whether it can be limited to 18 megabits per second during our weekday work hours i do not want a cap on downloads the current download speed is useful when i open a set of drawings and it should stay unchanged i found the setting name in the local configuration notes and i want the request to refer to it exactly
sync.limit_uploads
please set that key to 18 megabits per second from 9 in the morning until 5 in the afternoon on weekdays if the client cannot schedule a limit by time please tell me that before changing the setting because i would rather choose a steady all day limit than have someone guess at a schedule

one more thing the pauses in the activity list are confusing but i do not want the client to retry files more aggressively the network in the gallery is shared with the ticket desk and we agreed not to make large bursts during public hours last friday marta at the desk said the card reader had stalled twice while the photo folder was syncing she was not sure the sync caused it so please treat that as a concern to check rather than a confirmed cause the gallery router was restarted at 4 in the afternoon that day and the ticket desk worked normally after the restart

for the review could you check these three things number one whether the upload limit can be scheduled without changing download behavior number two whether the client shows which device started each upload and number three whether a pause caused by the limit resumes by itself once the upload queue is smaller i only need an explanation of what the client can do at this stage please do not turn on a new option while checking those points if you need an example the photo called east_wall_detail_07.jpg is 42 megabytes and the floor plan pdf called gallery_floor_plan_rev_c.pdf is 12 megabytes both are already in the shared folder and neither file should be renamed

we have a review with the installer on thursday at 10 in the morning and i can test a setting with dev after that meeting but not before because he is using the desktop for the lighting call if a change needs both devices to be signed out first please tell me that in advance and say whether the unsent notes on fieldbook remain local during the sign out i have three notes from this morning that are not final so losing or overwriting them would make the review harder the desktop was last restarted on wednesday at 6 20 in the evening and the laptop client version is 5.8.2 the desktop version is 5.8.2 as well

there is one old issue that may or may not be connected in march the client showed a warning for a folder called incoming scans but that folder is not part of north gallery install i removed it from the sync selection on april 2 and it has not appeared in the current activity list since then please do not add it back as a test the current selection should remain the floor plan lighting schedule vendor notes and walkthrough photos the supplier price sheet is stored in a separate folder and should stay outside this sync group

if it helps i can send a screenshot of the activity list after the afternoon install call and a copy of the client settings page i would prefer not to email the full folder because some vendor notes include private phone numbers also the installer asked us not to circulate the draft measurements beyond the project team so please tell me which limited details would be useful rather than requesting a complete export the next person covering the desk is omar and he can confirm whether there is another busy network period on friday

well the main request is to understand the scheduled upload limit and the related pause behavior before anyone changes the shared folder settings if a scheduled cap is supported then please tell me the steps and whether the same value can be used on juniper and fieldbook if it is not supported please explain the available choices without applying one and include whether the upload can remain unrestricted after 5 in the afternoon i want to have that information before the thursday review because we need to discuss the photo workflow with the installer and decide what to test afterward", "output": "Hi, this is Lena Ortiz from the North Gallery team, and I’m dictating a request about the shared-folder sync client we use for the exhibit planning files. I’m not asking anyone to move or delete the archive today. I need help making the current sync behavior predictable before our next round of edits. The folder is called North Gallery Install, and the working copy is on the office desktop named Juniper and on my laptop called Fieldbook. Those are the only two devices I want included in this request.

We started using the folder in February, and it now contains the floor plan, the lighting schedule, vendor notes, and photos from the walkthrough. There are 326 files in it, and the folder uses 8.4 gigabytes on the desktop. The laptop has 21 gigabytes free, so storage is not the problem. The issue is that when I open a large photo, the client sometimes starts uploading several other files at once, and the call with the installer gets choppy. I noticed it first on Monday morning while I was reviewing the east wall images with Dev Shah.

Please look at the upload setting in the client and tell me whether it can be limited to 18 megabits per second during our weekday work hours. I do not want a cap on downloads. The current download speed is useful when I open a set of drawings, and it should stay unchanged. I found the setting name in the local configuration notes, and I want the request to refer to it exactly.
sync.limit_uploads
Please set that key to 18 megabits per second from 9 in the morning until 5 in the afternoon on weekdays. If the client cannot schedule a limit by time, please tell me that before changing the setting, because I would rather choose a steady all-day limit than have someone guess at a schedule.

One more thing: the pauses in the activity list are confusing, but I do not want the client to retry files more aggressively. The network in the gallery is shared with the ticket desk, and we agreed not to make large bursts during public hours. Last Friday, Marta at the desk said the card reader had stalled twice while the photo folder was syncing. She was not sure the sync caused it, so please treat that as a concern to check rather than a confirmed cause. The gallery router was restarted at 4 in the afternoon that day, and the ticket desk worked normally after the restart.

For the review, could you check these three things: number one, whether the upload limit can be scheduled without changing download behavior; number two, whether the client shows which device started each upload; and number three, whether a pause caused by the limit resumes by itself once the upload queue is smaller. I only need an explanation of what the client can do at this stage. Please do not turn on a new option while checking those points. If you need an example, the photo called east_wall_detail_07.jpg is 42 megabytes, and the floor plan PDF called gallery_floor_plan_rev_c.pdf is 12 megabytes. Both files are already in the shared folder, and neither file should be renamed.

We have a review with the installer on Thursday at 10 in the morning, and I can test a setting with Dev after that meeting, but not before, because he is using the desktop for the lighting call. If a change needs both devices to be signed out first, please tell me that in advance and say whether the unsent notes on Fieldbook remain local during the sign-out. I have three notes from this morning that are not final, so losing or overwriting them would make the review harder. The desktop was last restarted on Wednesday at 6:20 in the evening, and the laptop client version is 5.8.2. The desktop version is 5.8.2 as well.

There is one old issue that may or may not be connected. In March, the client showed a warning for a folder called Incoming Scans, but that folder is not part of North Gallery Install. I removed it from the sync selection on April 2, and it has not appeared in the current activity list since then. Please do not add it back as a test. The current selection should remain the floor plan, lighting schedule, vendor notes, and walkthrough photos. The supplier price sheet is stored in a separate folder and should stay outside this sync group.

If it helps, I can send a screenshot of the activity list after the afternoon install call and a copy of the client settings page. I would prefer not to email the full folder because some vendor notes include private phone numbers. Also, the installer asked us not to circulate the draft measurements beyond the project team, so please tell me which limited details would be useful rather than requesting a complete export. The next person covering the desk is Omar, and he can confirm whether there is another busy network period on Friday.

Well, the main request is to understand the scheduled upload limit and the related pause behavior before anyone changes the shared-folder settings. If a scheduled cap is supported, then please tell me the steps and whether the same value can be used on Juniper and Fieldbook. If it is not supported, please explain the available choices without applying one, and include whether the upload can remain unrestricted after 5 in the afternoon. I want to have that information before the Thursday review, because we need to discuss the photo workflow with the installer and decide what to test afterward."}]
